layout.footer: You are receiving this email because you use Pitchorium.

technicalTest.subject: Pitchorium test email
technicalTest.heading: Test email
technicalTest.body: This email was sent on {{sentAt}} to check the delivery pipeline.

emailVerification.subject: Confirm your email address
emailVerification.preview: Confirm your email address to complete your Pitchorium account.
emailVerification.heading: Hello {{name}},
emailVerification.body: Confirm your email address to publish a project, contribute and write to members outside your network.
emailVerification.ignore: If you did not create a Pitchorium account, you can ignore this email.

magicLink.subject: Your Pitchorium sign-in link
magicLink.preview: Sign in to Pitchorium in one click.
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Pitchorium
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. This link works only once.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not request this link, you can ignore this email: your account remains protected.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: Choose a new password for your Pitchorium account.
passwordReset.heading: Hello {{name}},
passwordReset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. The link below works only once. All your sessions will be signed out after the change.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.preview: Your Pitchorium account was signed in to.
newSignIn.heading: Hello {{name}},
newSignIn.body: Your account was signed in to on {{signedInAt}} (UTC) from the following device: {{device}}.
newSignIn.notYou: If this was not you, sign out your sessions and change your password right away.
newSignIn.reason: You receive this email for every sign-in from a new device.

signInMethodChanged.subject: Your sign-in methods changed
signInMethodChanged.preview: A sign-in method of your Pitchorium account was changed.
signInMethodChanged.heading: Hello {{name}},

changes.linked: {{method}} was added to your sign-in methods on {{changedAt}} (UTC).
changes.unlinked: {{method}} was removed from your sign-in methods on {{changedAt}} (UTC).
changes.password_reset: Your password was reset on {{changedAt}} (UTC). All your sessions were signed out.

signInMethodChanged.notYou: If you did not make this change, secure your account right away.
signInMethodChanged.reason: You receive this email for every change of your sign-in methods.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join {{organization}} on Pitchorium
invitation.body: {{member}} invites you to join {{organization}} on Pitchorium as {{role}}. Create your account or sign in with this email address, then accept the invitation.
invitation.note: This invitation works once and expires on {{expiresAt}} (UTC). If you do not know this organization, ignore this email.

ownership_transferred.subject: Ownership of {{organization}} was transferred
ownership_transferred.body: Ownership of {{organization}} was transferred to {{member}}. The previous owner remains an administrator.

verification_requested.subject: Verification request received for {{organization}}
verification_requested.preview: A moderator will review your verification request.
verification_requested.body: We received the verification request of {{organization}}. A moderator will review it; you will be told of the decision by email.

verification_approved.subject: {{organization}} is verified
verification_approved.preview: The verification badge is shown on the page of {{organization}}.
verification_approved.body: The verification of {{organization}} is approved: the verification badge is now shown on its page.

verification_rejected.subject: Verification of {{organization}} declined
verification_rejected.preview: The verification request of {{organization}} was not approved.
verification_rejected.body: The verification request of {{organization}} was not approved.
verification_rejected.note: You may submit a new request with additional documents.

verification_revoked.subject: Verification of {{organization}} withdrawn
verification_revoked.preview: The verification badge of {{organization}} was withdrawn.
verification_revoked.body: The verification badge of {{organization}} was withdrawn by the moderation team.

contributionConfirmation.subject: Your contribution to {{project}} is confirmed
contributionConfirmation.heading: Hello {{name}},
contributionConfirmation.body: Your contribution of {{amount}} to the project {{project}} was paid on {{paidAt}} (UTC).

kinds.reward_crowdfunding: This is a contribution with a reward.
kinds.love_money: This is a love money contribution.

contributionConfirmation.commission: Pitchorium keeps a commission of {{commission}}. The rest goes to the holder through our licensed payment provider, minus its fees: Pitchorium never holds your money.
contributionConfirmation.notTaxReceipt: This email confirms your payment. It is not a tax receipt.
contributionConfirmation.mentions: The impact of the project is self-declared by its holder. A donation is not a financial security, and an unlocked tier is not a guarantee of success.

intro.daily: Here is what happened today on Pitchorium.
intro.weekly: Here is what happened this week on Pitchorium.

unreadMessages.note: You receive a copy of your unread messages because you turned it on in your notification settings on Pitchorium.
